footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to CPKC: includes C$4.0M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.7% to C$15.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 96.9%, versus 97.2% a year earlier, and operating income rose 8.3% to C$5.6B, a 37.2% margin.
Net income rose 11.4% to C$4.1B, or C$4.51 per share. Operating cash flow was C$5.3B and free cash flow C$2.2B, versus C$2.4B; CPKC returned C$4.7B through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Free cash flow fell 9.7% to C$2.2B.
sources: Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
